mostWorthwhile.text: Building the muscle pulling proteins was most worthwhile: the picture showed how overlapping fibres can slide to shorten a cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: The supporting-cell path felt a little repetitive after the similar muscle path, although the final outside-the-cell result gave it a purpose.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the supporting cells to release their proteins to form material around themselves, rather than keep them inside like the muscle cells.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The messenger pairings were named, and the pictures linked them to different active genes, though I was following those hints rather than figuring out how the messengers work.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these different cells become tissues, though I'd hope for more varied choices than the repeated protein-building steps.
